body.statement: For every \(P\in\mathcal P^{\mathrm{obs}}\) and \(c\in I\), \(q_c=w(\tau-c)\). Consequently, \([\epsilon(1-\epsilon)]^2V(P)\le\inf_{c\in I}\|q_c\|_{L^2(\lambda)}^2\le V(P)/16\).
body.justification: This identity turns homogeneity into a positive profiled conditional-moment energy without inverse propensity weights.
body.gap: CrumpHotzImbensMitnik2008 tests constant CATE through a different nonparametric construction and does not state this coercive observed-score reduction.
body.consumer: The identity supplies the population target for a bounded-weight implementation of the constant-CATE option in the dScoreTest software.
